2610.08036.title: Same Feedback, Different Answer: Measuring Run-to-Run Instability in Frontier-Model Customer Feedback Analysis
2610.08036.paper_summary: AI agents are increasingly being programmed to automate knowledge work over large collections of unstructured data. Such automation requires repeatability: when the underlying evidence is unchanged, the agent's categories, priorities, and counts should not shift materially between runs, even if each individual answer appears plausible. We introduce a repeat-run evaluation framework that aligns semantically equivalent categories and focuses on two operating metrics: theme churn, the normalized change in the returned category set, and volume disagreement, the change in counts for categories that persist. We evaluate three recurring customer-feedback tasks across eight frontier models, corpus sizes from 100 to 5,000 records, multiple prompts, and three execution designs: raw generation, taxonomy-free hierarchical decomposition, and a taxonomy-grounded agent (TGA) using persistent themes, subthemes, and record-level predictions. With Claude Opus 4.8 and the 1,000-record corpus fixed, TGA reduces theme churn by 86--88% relative to both raw generation and hierarchical decomposition, while matched-theme volumes have zero disagreement. The taxonomy-grounded agent is more stable than every raw model in the screen, remains more stable at each corpus size, and keeps this advantage when theme matching is made stricter or looser. Although evaluated on customer feedback, the framework targets repeated synthesis of unstructured corpora more broadly, including financial reports, legal documents, incident records, and scientific literature. Overall, these results show that taxonomy grounding produces more consistent and repeatable outputs for recurring knowledge work.
2610.08036.paper_summary_zh: AI 代理人越來越多地被編程以自動化大量非結構化數據的知識工作。這種自動化需要可重複性：當基礎證據不變時，代理人的類別、優先級和計數在多次運行之間不應有實質性的變化，即使每個單獨的答案看起來都合理。我們引入了一個重複運行評估框架，對齊語義上等價的類別，並專注於兩個運行指標：主題變更，即返回的類別集的標準化變化，以及數量不一致，即持續存在的類別的計數變化。我們在八個前沿模型上評估了三個重複的客戶反饋任務，語料庫大小從 100 到 5,000 條記錄，多個提示，以及三種執行設計：原始生成、無分類法的層次分解，以及使用持久主題、副主題和記錄級預測的分類法基礎代理（TGA）。在 Claude Opus 4.8 和 1,000 條記錄的語料庫固定的情況下，TGA 相對於原始生成和層次分解將主題變更降低了 86--88%，而匹配主題的數量則沒有不一致。分類法基礎的代理比屏幕中的每個原始模型更穩定，在每個語料庫大小下保持更穩定，並在主題匹配變得更嚴格或更寬鬆時保持這一優勢。儘管是在客戶反饋上進行評估，但該框架更廣泛地針對非結構化語料庫的重複合成，包括財務報告、法律文件、事件記錄和科學文獻。總體而言，這些結果顯示，分類法基礎能夠為重複的知識工作產生更一致和可重複的輸出。
